media.title: Eddy Duchin — publicity portrait
media.altText: Black-and-white publicity portrait of the bandleader and pianist Eddy Duchin.
media.publicCaption: Eddy Duchin, whose orchestra made the first American recording of a Kaper song — “You’re All I Need” (Victor 25029, 1935), with vocal by Lew Sherwood.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: publicity portrait reproduced in Billboard and released as public domain via Wikimedia Commons.
